purpose: Fresh GitHub clone continuation training, DGX host benchmark and reconstruction of the selected finite-command inference delivery
training: Six matched VCM continuation fits, own pinned initializers, two widths and two objectives at seed 53, both objectives at development-selected width at seed 67. Downloaded completed VCM fits and their evaluation caches are excluded. Wake and owner completed project fits remain verified companions.
selection: Unchanged development-only selection and calibration; test may veto promotion to the predeclared baseline, never retune thresholds.
isolation: Tracked Git sources copied into a unique ignored run workspace. One bootstrapped environment per clone. No source-machine model or data cache links. Frozen historical results remain in the source clone and are backed up before regenerating the named derived files in the run workspace.
exactness: Compare the selected ONNX and complete deployment bundle with the Git-owned reference. A retained frozen baseline is reported as retained, not freshly reconstructed from random initialization. Training floating-point results need not be bit-identical across devices.
device_policy: One device only; CPU default. Select one available CUDA device with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES and --device cuda. Never interrupt other users' jobs.
unmeasured: full historical initializer training chain replay
